ranked.headline: Guided generative models steer protein and molecule design with structural feedback
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply guiding potentials and iterative feedback to protein and molecule generative design.

ranked.headline: Inferring regulatory programs and cell states from single-cell and spatial data
ranked.summary: Single-cell ATAC, RNA, and spatial datasets now support scalable inference of regulatory activity, pathway, and cell-type communication programs.

ranked.headline: Reducing patch volume and annotation needs in histopathology analysis
ranked.summary: Recent histopathology work seeks to cut patch volume, annotation burden, or input scale while targeting tumour segmentation and prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Protein language model embeddings fused with structure, binding sites, and chemistry
ranked.summary: Pretrained protein language model embeddings are increasingly combined with 3D structure, binding-site, text, and chemical encoders in shared latent spaces.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking and automating structure-based modeling of biomolecular complexes
ranked.summary: Docking, MD, and generative design tools are being benchmarked and packaged into automated workflows for antibodies, PROTACs, and RNA targets.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks test small LLM agents and new Python tools for transcriptomic analysis
ranked.summary: Lightweight open-weight LLM agents are now benchmarked against deterministic methods for spatial transcriptomics annotation alongside new analysis software.

ranked.headline: Chromatin readouts map regulatory programs and 3D genome organization across cell types
ranked.summary: Single-nucleus multi-omics and cross-tissue contact atlases now apply chromatin readouts to disease contexts and 3D genome architecture.

ranked.headline: Latent models infer single-cell dynamics, gene regulation, and RNA-protein kinetics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair learned or mechanistic models with single-cell data to reconstruct trajectories, regulatory networks, and expression kinetics.

ranked.headline: Computational scrutiny of RNA-chromatin artifacts and intronic polyadenylation sites
ranked.summary: Recent studies test whether RNA-chromatin, 3'UTR, and polyadenylation inferences reflect biology rather than technical artifacts.

ranked.headline: Standardized tools make proteomics and omics analysis reproducible and traceable
ranked.summary: Recent releases target reproducibility gaps in proteomics preprocessing, ML model serving, and standardized environments for omics workflows.

ranked.headline: Pretrained language model embeddings feed RNA and miRNA prediction models
ranked.summary: Pretrained sequence and text embeddings are now used as inputs to RNA methylation, miRNA target, and gene-level predictors.

ranked.headline: Computational models refine cell typing, marker detection and spatial RNA localization
ranked.summary: November 2025 preprints and publications introduce methods for cross-platform annotation, spatial denoising, and splicing-aware quantification.

ranked.headline: Learned and model-free methods map RNA modifications and non-coding variant effects
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair new models and benchmarks with installable software for variant interpretation and signature calling.

ranked.headline: Proteome-wide models predict interactions, disorder grammars and segment boundaries
ranked.summary: Predictions now span whole human proteomes, from interaction screening to disorder grammars and language-model segmentation of protein sequences.

ranked.headline: Multimodal and interpretable models predict compound toxicity and bioactivity endpoints
ranked.summary: Public Tox21, DILImap, and exposome-scale datasets now enable multimodal toxicity models that add interpretability and pharmacokinetic context.

ranked.headline: Trajectory constraints improve regulatory dynamics inference from single-cell data
ranked.summary: Single-cell data now supports lineage-aware models of gene regulation, from cell-cycle constraints to Ornstein-Uhlenbeck expression evolution.

ranked.headline: Generative and language models now design protein, peptide, and mRNA sequences
ranked.summary: Pretrained and generative sequence models are moving from property prediction toward controllable design across proteins and coding RNA.

ranked.headline: Marker genes guide phylogeny, metagenome coassembly, and genome quality assessment
ranked.summary: Expanding sequence collections make automated marker selection and standardized quality assessment practical priorities for downstream accuracy.

ranked.headline: Learned models operate directly on raw microscopy and cryo-EM observations
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published method apply learned or training-free models directly to image-level observations across microscopy, cryo-ET and cryoEM.

ranked.headline: Analysis tools for DIA proteomics, MS metadata, and metabolite annotation
ranked.summary: Four new preprints release analysis software for MS proteomics, metabolomics, and imaging data, emphasizing benchmarks and metadata provenance.

ranked.headline: Spatial neighborhood context enters perturbation modeling and differential expression
ranked.summary: Spatial transcriptomics platforms such as Xenium, MERFISH and Visium HD now support neighborhood-aware statistical and perturbation models.

ranked.headline: Multimodal LLMs couple omics, DNA, and protein data with natural-language querying
ranked.summary: Five recent preprints and publications apply language-model interfaces to metabolomic, transcriptomic, genomic, and protein data.

ranked.headline: Knowledge graphs underpin deployable biomedical prediction and literature retrieval tools
ranked.summary: Recent preprints package knowledge-graph models for drug repositioning and literature RAG as accessible tools, alongside LLM-based spectral prediction.

ranked.headline: MD resolves loop flexibility and allosteric coupling across viral and bacterial proteins
ranked.summary: Coarse-grained and all-atom MD now pair flexible-region sampling with allosteric network analysis across several protein classes.

ranked.headline: Alignment-light methods advance prokaryotic genome and metagenomic analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications introduce scalable index structures and alignment-free methods for prokaryotic and metagenomic sequence analysis.

ranked.headline: Computational models track pathogen genome evolution, recombination and transmission
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply mixture-of-experts, hidden Markov and genetic algorithm models to viral and resistance evolution and transmission…

ranked.headline: Genome mining reveals antimicrobial peptides and effectors from microbial genomes
ranked.summary: Expanding genome and metagenome catalogues now enable systematic mining of antimicrobials, bacteriocins and effectors from extreme and gut environments.

ranked.headline: Learned models link transcription, annotation bias and developmental gene regulation
ranked.summary: Cross-species expression and splicing comparisons now depend on annotation evidence and on matched transcription and abundance measurements.

ranked.headline: Long-read tools add methylation linkage, standardized storage and benchmarking to genome…
ranked.summary: Long-read genomics tools now exploit methylation, raw signals and standardized benchmarks to improve haplotype and variant accuracy.

ranked.headline: ML models map sequence and structure to ligand, pocket, and peptide-MHC recognition
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply graph networks, AlphaFold2 extensions, and interpretable XGBoost to binding-site, docking, and epitope prediction.

ranked.headline: Computational and proteomic profiling resolve metabolic pathway structure and flux
ranked.summary: Genome-scale flux modeling, dynamic acyl-proteomics, and isotope labeling now resolve metabolic routes from sequence to pathway topology.

ranked.headline: Learned representations probe biomolecular kinetics and metastable states from simulation
ranked.summary: Physics-informed learning, VAE-driven adaptive sampling, and Markov state models are now applied together to MD-derived kinetics and ensemble behavior.

ranked.headline: Finite element and surrogate models couple microstructure to tissue mechanical output
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple parameter sensitivity, sarcomere microstructure, and Bayesian inverse inference to tissue-scale mechanics.

ranked.headline: Computational models link EEG dynamics to sleep, consciousness, and entrainment
ranked.summary: Complexity measures, individually fitted mechanistic models, and adaptive stimulation are now being applied to EEG-based brain state read-outs.

ranked.headline: Experimental benchmarks test folding energy and sequence models for protein variants
ranked.summary: Mega-scale folding and aggregation datasets now provide stringent experimental tests for energy-based and sequence-based predictors of protein variant effects.

ranked.headline: Persistent homology and Grassmann geometry recover multiscale structure in omics data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply persistent homology and Grassmann manifolds to multiscale spatial and single-cell omics data.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-scale nutcracker genome and spruce SNP array for population genetics
ranked.summary: Chromosome-scale references and reference-free diversity tools now enable demographic and hybridization inference in nonmodel species.

ranked.headline: Viscoelastic aging and sticker-spacer modeling define condensate material states
ranked.summary: Recent preprints add an open sticker-spacer simulation pipeline and a viscoelastic aging model for condensate material state.

ranked.headline: Emergent system-level constraints set survival and stability outcomes across models
ranked.summary: Recent preprints treat survival and stability as emergent properties of whole systems, spanning ecosystems, cell models, and multi-agent flocks.

ranked.headline: Brain imaging representations engineered for subject, patient, or topological properties
ranked.summary: Representation design is becoming the locus for modeling individual variability in fMRI, MRI/PET, and dynamic connectivity.
